source.title: Theoretical Test Questions for the Learner's Licence
source.quality_assurance: Namibian German Centre for Logistics (Polytechnic of Namibia)

field_notes.answer: null everywhere. NOT YET SOURCED. Do not guess-fill: a learners' app that teaches a wrong answer is worse than no app.
field_notes.needs_official_source: true = answer is a Namibia-specific legal figure or rule that must come from the official Learner's book / NaTIS, not from general road-rules knowledge.
field_notes.image: null = pure text question, renderable today. Object = question cannot be answered without artwork. 'options' means each of A/B/C is itself a picture.
field_notes.status: ok = usable once answer is filled. blocked = unusable as-is, see reason.
